title: Lancasters ME625 and ND981
memorial_details: A metal plaque mounted on a back board, the plaque has a colour badge of 97 Squadron RAF at top centre, and either side are lightly etched depictions of two Lancaster aircraft. The inscription is below with names in two columns by aircraft crew, all etched and in white.
inscription: Plaque inscription: (97 Squadron badge)/ IN THE SURROUNDING FIELDS LIE THE REMAINS OF LANCASTERS/ ME625 AND ND981 OF 97 SQUADRON RAF BOMBER COMMAND/ WHICH CAME TO REST WITH THEIR CREWS,/ THE RESULT OF A TRAGIC ACCIDENT/ 23RD JUNE 1944/ ME625/ (Names)/ ND981/ (Names)/ UNVEILED BY THE RELATIVES FOR THE 70TH ANNIVERSARY./ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA
community_connection: unveiled by the relatives for the 70th anniversary
